## **Preis und Paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Preis und Paywall.**
      1 aktuelle Review(s) erwähnen preis und paywall.
      Review-Fenster: 04.09.2026 - 04.09.2026
      **Warum das zählt:** Nutzer erwähnen Preis, Abos oder Paywalls. Das kann Preissensibilität in der Nische signalisieren.

         **Review-Beispiele:**
            1. _Anthony C_, 04.09.2026, 1/5: "It does not synch sometimes to health connect it did not record my activity today. I even downloaded health sync and paid for the one time purchase subscription. still not synching. Even in Strava it sometimes does not sync, you have manually upload your activity which is a hassle. Been using Xiaomi Watch 5 during activity in the middle of the run it glitched and you have to start over again. Happened twice now in one month of use. I'm beginning to regret buying a Xiaomi watch too many issues."
